title: Exact EMR4 Context Fabric structural durability migration/transaction architecture v3
description: Whole-contract constant. Structural renderer inputs are closed; entry-point and trigger bodies remain a separately closed gate and the architecture remains unmounted and non-executable.

const.temporal_obligation_sql: OLD.start_time IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.start_time OR OLD.duration_minutes IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.duration_minutes

check_constraints.name: ck_cf_04_02
check_constraints.expression_sql: ((entry_kind = 'PRIMARY'::emr4_context_fabric.admission_entry_kind AND observation_digest IS NOT NULL AND decision IS NOT NULL AND reason_code IS NOT NULL AND affected_frame_mask IS NOT NULL AND checkpoint_disposition IS NOT NULL AND attempted_admission_digest IS NULL AND conflict_reason IS NULL) OR (entry_kind = 'CONFLICT'::emr4_context_fabric.admission_entry_kind AND observation_digest IS NULL AND decision IS NULL AND reason_code IS NULL AND affected_frame_mask IS NULL AND checkpoint_disposition IS NULL AND attempted_admission_digest IS NOT NULL AND conflict_reason IS NOT NULL))

check_constraints.name: ck_cf_06_03
check_constraints.expression_sql: ((lifecycle_state = 'CONSUMED'::emr4_context_fabric.generation_state AND consumed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (lifecycle_state <> 'CONSUMED'::emr4_context_fabric.generation_state AND consumed_at IS NULL))

check_constraints.name: ck_cf_07_03
check_constraints.expression_sql: ((last_contiguous_position = 0 AND last_observation_digest IS NULL) OR (last_contiguous_position > 0 AND last_observation_digest IS NOT NULL))

check_constraints.name: ck_cf_10_02
check_constraints.expression_sql: ((lifecycle_state = 'RETIRED'::emr4_context_fabric.frame_lifecycle AND retired_at IS NOT NULL) OR (lifecycle_state = 'CURRENT'::emr4_context_fabric.frame_lifecycle AND retired_at IS NULL))

check_constraints.name: ck_cf_13_02
check_constraints.expression_sql: ((entry_kind = 'DECISION'::emr4_context_fabric.lifecycle_entry_kind AND source_position IS NOT NULL AND key_interval_start IS NULL AND key_interval_end IS NULL) OR (entry_kind = 'KEY_ROTATION'::emr4_context_fabric.lifecycle_entry_kind AND source_position IS NULL AND key_interval_start IS NOT NULL AND key_interval_end IS NOT NULL AND key_interval_end > key_interval_start))

check_constraints.name: ck_cf_16_01
check_constraints.expression_sql: ((pin_state = 'RELEASED'::emr4_context_fabric.recovery_pin_state AND released_at IS NOT NULL) OR (pin_state = 'ACTIVE'::emr4_context_fabric.recovery_pin_state AND released_at IS NULL))

check_constraints.name: ck_cf_17_03
check_constraints.expression_sql: active_until IS NULL OR active_until > active_from

policies.using_sql: current_user = 'context_schema_owner'::name AND database_login = session_user AND active_from <= transaction_timestamp() AND (active_until IS NULL OR active_until > transaction_timestamp())

const.name: session_binding_allows_v1
const.body_sql: SELECT count(*) = 1 FROM emr4_context_fabric.context_service_practice_binding AS binding WHERE binding.database_login = authenticated_login AND binding.database_login = session_user AND binding.logical_capability = ANY (allowed_capabilities) AND binding.practice_id = requested_practice_id AND binding.source_contract_id = requested_source_contract_id AND binding.active_from <= observed_at AND (binding.active_until IS NULL OR binding.active_until > observed_at)

const.predicate: Every relevant claim, appointment current tuple, audit and event member has xmin equal to the exact low-XID32 expression; every alias, head and outbox member is authored by the same top-level transaction. Subtransaction-authored relevant tuples fail. A savepoint with no relevant tuple is not observable.

(OLD.start_time IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.start_time OR OLD.duration_minutes IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.duration_minutes) is true exactly when one current-transaction reschedule event, alias, head advance and outbox exist; false requires their absence.
The raw_event_uuid is checked against exactly one current-transaction diary_committed_events row before commit; no persistent foreign key to diary_committed_events exists.

UPDATE of the exact product event is rejected; DELETE is rejected only while OLD.xmin is the current top-level transaction. The outbox raw_event_uuid is transaction-locally checked before commit but has no persistent foreign key to diary_committed_events, so later product-event expiry or separately authorised deletion neither deletes nor invalidates the independent outbox and grants no source-purge authority.
The practice/source/product UUID and practice/source/opaque alias mappings are both unique; rows cannot update or delete in source epoch 1.
A locked stream head advances by exactly one with predecessor equal to the prior head and rolls back with the outbox.
Outbox rows cannot update or delete except through the separately disabled retention entry point after eligibility.
At most one PRIMARY and one CONFLICT exist per generation position; exact duplicate is inert and the first mismatch is durably bounded.
Generation registration, rebaseline, retention evaluation and purge lock the same practice/source/stream barrier.
Generation lifecycle transitions are one-way and terminal states do not reactivate.
The locked checkpoint advances monotonically or enters a terminal/rebase state and never regresses.
Baseline and post-transition anchors append once and cannot update or delete.
No next decision or rotation begins until the latest independently reverified anchor exactly matches the committed checkpoint.
Receipts append once and exact redelivery returns the stored row without mutation.
Every receipt references the PRIMARY admission at the same complete coordinate.
A RETIRED frame generation cannot become CURRENT.
Watermarks never decrease and never exceed the locked checkpoint last_contiguous_position.
The coordinator derives one pending obligation and its count bucket from canonical admitted audit history; callers supply neither.
Lifecycle revisions append without gap or reuse and partition exactly into DECISION and KEY_ROTATION.
Each audit row references exactly one DECISION lifecycle revision and no KEY_ROTATION revision.
Key intervals form one generation-local ordered gap-free non-overlapping partition and rotation changes only a future interval.
Recovery pins append and may only transition ACTIVE to RELEASED.
Exactly one active logical capability, practice, source and credential epoch binding may exist per authenticated login; zero or more than one denies.
Architecture fixes retention_execution_enabled to FALSE and policy rows are append-only.
Eligibility is derived inside the database from the complete non-consumed generation census, pins, key overlap and grace under the registry barrier.
